liga-privada--liga-privada-no-9.description: Drew Estate's Liga Privada No. 9 is made in Nicaragua with a dark Connecticut River Valley broadleaf wrapper, a plantation-grown Brazilian Mata Fina binder and Nicaraguan and Honduran filler. Full-bodied and dense, it is built on deep, meaty earth and espresso with a long finish; a cigar for experienced smokers and unhurried evenings.

sources.title: Blind Man's Puff – Liga Privada No. 9 Robusto blind review
The Cigar Authority – Liga Privada No. 9 Corona Doble review

thirds.notes: Rich spice and lingering pepper with a charred, meaty note, cocoa and caramel, or figs and molasses with a touch of leather.
Bold and peppery, with coffee or leather as the main note, raisin, wood and a mesquite-like smoke on the retrohale.
Cleaner pepper and herbal notes, then char, dark chocolate, espresso and plenty of leather and wood to the end.

liga-privada--liga-privada-t52.description: T52 uses a Habano wrapper grown for Drew Estate in Connecticut, cut and cured on the whole stalk, then aged 30 to 36 months because of the leaf's thickness. A Brazilian Mata Fina binder and Honduran and Nicaraguan filler complete the blend. Full-bodied, it shows earth and black pepper with a caramel sweetness on the finish.

sources.title: The Cigar Authority – Liga Privada T52 review
The Cigar Authority – Liga Privada T52 Toro Tubo review

thirds.notes: Chocolate and cedar lead with subtle spice and a peppery aroma, until the sweetness fades into charred wood.
Sweetness returns with cocoa, molasses and cinnamon, wood on the finish and a sharp, wasabi-like pepper in the aroma.
The sweetness drops away again and wood dominates, ending on a moderate, earthy finish.

liga-privada--liga-privada-h99.description: The third chapter of Liga Privada, H99 is a tribute to the Connecticut River Valley, wrapped in a hybrid leaf that joins stalk-cut Habano with Corojo '99. A Mexican San Andrés binder holds Nicaraguan, Honduran and Pennsylvania Green River filler. Full but balanced, it pairs an espresso core with leather and a sweet cedar character.

liga-privada--liga-privada-10-aniversari.description: Created to mark ten years since the No. 9 first appeared, Liga Privada 10 Aniversario uses a Connecticut-grown Criollo hybrid wrapper, a Mexican San Andrés binder and Nicaraguan and Pennsylvania Green River filler. Dense and full-bodied, it brings repeated waves of pepper and spice over a savoury note the maker likens to sharp cheddar.

sources.title: Cigar Coop – Liga Privada 10 Aniversario Robusto review
Cigar Coop – Liga Privada 10 Aniversario Toro review

thirds.notes: Coffee bean moves ahead of wood and earth early, with fruit in the background, a little chocolate and mixed pepper on the retrohale.
Coffee stays in front while earth sometimes steps up, with pepper, wood, fruit and chocolate around it.
Coffee remains the core and white pepper becomes the strongest supporting note, slowly gaining in intensity.

liga-privada--liga-privada-10-seleccion-.description: Selección de Mercado, or market selection, refers to an old practice of grading wrapper leaf; here a reddish rosado Connecticut Criollo is chosen for a blend made for markets outside the United States. With a Mexican San Andrés binder and Nicaraguan and Pennsylvania filler, it is medium to full, peppery, with a rich espresso core.

sources.title: Drew Estate – Liga Privada 10 Selección de Mercado

liga-privada--unico-serie.description: Único Serie gathers Liga Privada's small-production blends and unusual formats, each with its own recipe. It includes the T52-wrapped Dirty Rat and its creamier, longer sibling Ratzilla, the broadleaf Year of the Rat and Velvet Rat coronas, the pigtailed Feral Flying Pig and the L40 lancero. Most lean full-bodied.

sources.title: Drew Estate – Liga Privada Único Serie

liga-privada--papas-fritas.description: Papas Fritas is a short-filler cigar made from the hand-sorted, hand-cut trimmings of Liga Privada production, wrapped in Connecticut broadleaf over a Brazilian Mata Fina binder with Nicaraguan and Honduran tobacco. Medium to full, spicy and rich, it offers cocoa, leather and coffee in a smoke of about thirty minutes.

sources.title: Drew Estate – Liga Privada Papas Fritas
